title: Как устроен процесс
description: Описываем производство и обслуживание в Present Simple Passive, когда исполнитель не важен.
notes: Пассив строится be + причастие: The parcels are checked.
В описании процесса исполнитель часто не называется, если он очевиден.

exercises.prompt: Как описать регулярную доставку без указания курьера?

options.label: The parcels are delivered every morning.
The parcels are deliver every morning.

exercises.editorial_answer: The parcels are delivered every morning.
exercises.explanation: Are delivered — пассивная форма с причастием.

exercises.prompt: Дополни предложение подходящим словом или краткой формой.
exercises.explanation: После is для пассива нужно причастие made.

exercises.editorial_answer: The bottles are washed before they are filled.
exercises.explanation: Оба действия над бутылками выражены пассивом.

public_payload.sentence: Every order is check before delivery.

accepted: Every order is checked before delivery.

exercises.reference_answer: Every order is checked before delivery.
exercises.incorrect_answer: Every order is check before delivery.
exercises.editorial_answer: Every order is checked before delivery.

accepted: These bicycles are made in Italy.
These bikes are manufactured in Italy.

exercises.reference_answer: These bicycles are made in Italy.
exercises.editorial_answer: These bicycles are made in Italy.
exercises.explanation: Are made/manufactured показывает действие над велосипедами.

options.label: They are labelled with the date.
They are delivered to customers' homes.

public_payload.passage: At a small food company, vegetables are delivered early each morning. They are inspected and washed before they are cut. The prepared vegetables are packed in sealed containers, which are labelled with the date. Some orders are collected by local cafés, while others are delivered to homes. Products that fail the inspection are not used in customer orders.

exercises.explanation: Перед cut в тексте стоят inspected and washed.

options.label: No, the orders are packed by our staff.
Yes, our staff packs every order for them.

lines.speaker: Visitor
lines.text: Do customers pack the orders themselves?

exercises.editorial_answer: No, the orders are packed by our staff.
exercises.explanation: Отрицательный ответ и passive by our staff согласуются с вопросом.

public_payload.sentence: All application letters ___ read before interviews are arranged.

exercises.explanation: Letters во множественном числе требует are.
